Args: fullname: The user's full name. biography: A multi‑sentence biography provided by the user. status_message: A brief, current status update from the user. Returns: A string containing the sanitized and formatted profile information ready to be embedded in an HTML page. Raises: TypeError: If any argument is not a string. ValueError: If any argument is an empty string after stripping whitespace. """ # Validate input types for arg_name, value in ( ("fullname", fullname), ("biography", biography), ("status_message", status_message), ): if not isinstance(value, str): raise TypeError(f"{arg_name} must be a string, got {type(value).__name__}") # Trim whitespace and check for emptiness if not fullname.strip(): raise ValueError("fullname cannot be empty or whitespace only") if not biography.strip(): raise ValueError("biography cannot be empty or whitespace only") if not status_message.strip(): raise ValueError("status_message cannot be empty or whitespace only") # Escape user‑supplied content to prevent XSS safe_name = html.escape(fullname.strip(), quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography.strip(), quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message.strip(), quote=True) # Render the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status)
